description: This file defines the 'Recent' controller class for the Opencart admin dashboard extension, handling display and saving of recent order data and dashboard configuration.

classes.name: Recent
classes.description: Controller class for managing the recent orders dashboard widget in Opencart admin.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the recent orders dashboard configuration page, setting up breadcrumbs, layout, and view.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving dashboard configuration settings, with permission check and JSON response.

methods.name: dashboard
methods.description: Retrieves the latest 5 orders and renders the recent info view.
